thread:
Evan (Sales Eng): Heads-up: Meridian sent an RFI and wants a 7-day POC. Requests: US-only processing, SOC2 evidence, KMIP-compatible HSM, baseline 4 GPUs with burst to 10, and a capability matrix mapped to their controls. Need non-binding pricing and a short runbook for infra by EOD.

Priya (AE): Copy. Do they require Private (VPC) or can we do Dedicated hosted? Also ask if encryption-in-transit endpoints must be customer-owned certs.

Evan (Sales Eng): They asked for Private in their VPC and want customer certs for mutual TLS. Also want sample SLOs and rollback plan.

Marco (SRE): Private POC doable. Timeline: peering + 2-node (2 GPUs each) baseline in ~36h; to reach 4 GPUs we'll scale nodes. KMIP/HSM integration is a 7-10 day path and needs SOW. Minimal infra steps for them:

```bash
# run on Meridian bastion
curl -X POST https://peering.redwood.ai/v1/request -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"cidr":"10.91.0.0/21","env":"meridian-poc"}'
# we return peering config + agent bundle
```

Zoe (Solutions): I'm attaching a trimmed capability matrix and a one-page RFI mapping (uploaded to shared drive). Key callouts: model catalog (open + fine-tune), prefix KV caching, routing fallback tiers, observability hooks, and per-route token cost breakdown. Will redact the SOC2 and attach.

Priya (AE): For pricing, suggest: promo - 50% off compute for first 7 days and waive onboarding. Need baseline reserved equivalent cost + per-GPU burst hourly.

Marco (SRE): Ballpark non-binding: 4xA100-eq reserved ~ $17k/mo; burst ~$14/GPU-hr; egress ~$0.08/GB. With 50% promo for 7 days estimate ~$1.9k assuming moderate burst. If they require dedicated customer cert mTLS and HSM, add integration fee and lead time.

compliance-bot: SOC2 Type II (redacted) attached per request.

Evan (Sales Eng): I'll draft the RFI reply with Zoe's matrix, Marco's snippet, and the non-binding quote. Priya, approve promo?

Priya (AE): Approved. Include trial cap: 7 days, max burst 10 GPUs, trial support at standard level. Note: any contract addendum for HSM or data residency must be mutually signed.

Marco (SRE): I'll prepare a short rollback runbook: scale down workers, revoke peering, and rotate keys. Will paste into the email thread.

Evan (Sales Eng): Great — sending to meridian@meridian.io now.
